measuringSessionReading.grounds: findOneById took an ownerWorkspaceId scope but the where clause also accepted rows whose ownerWorkspaceId is NULL, so a caller from any workspace could act on an unowned registration by id; the fix removes the IsNull alternative so only the caller's tenant rows match.

secondReader.sentence: findOneById scoped by ownerWorkspaceId also matched registrations with a NULL owner, letting any workspace act on registrations it does not own; fix removes the IsNull fallback so the lookup is strictly tenant-scoped.
secondReader.answerLinesHint: -      where: [ { id, ownerWorkspaceId }, { id, ownerWorkspaceId: IsNull() } ], / +      where: { id, ownerWorkspaceId },
